acceptance_predicates.description: The current-main installed asb tui install path reproduces the reported trusted_tool_invalid failure before the repair and records the exact failing validator.
Development permission/ownership findings for the supported rustup/rustc layout are warning-only and do not return trusted_tool_invalid.
Traversal, symlink substitution, malformed settings, missing tools, descriptor replacement, and incompatible toolchain pairing remain typed hard failures.
The exact current ASB/asb-tui installed-entrypoint journey reaches materialization/status/launch without provider credentials.
Stable and production trust policy is unchanged; no ambient PATH or arbitrary tool execution is introduced.
Human output remains actionable by default and --json reports the same warning/error facts without secrets.

Focused and locked tests pass on the exact reviewed head.
Post-merge installed-entrypoint evidence proves the user-visible failure is repaired.
